static_traits.name: 张静文
static_traits.family_status: Lives with parents；有一名姐妹及外甥、外甥Female
static_traits.social_status: Mainly relies on family support, especially her older sister; due to the pressure of studies and caring for her parents, her relationship with her family was tense for a while recently
static_traits.medical_history: without重要躯体疾病；此前not yet接受心理治疗；过去not yet出现类似的学业恐惧
static_traits.language_features: 配合度高、表达清晰，能描述Anxiety与自动化想法；存在灾难化、negate积极与预测失败的倾向，整体态度积极

basic_info.main_problem: 我担心自己without法通过学位的期末考试，尽管我已接近完成学位。
basic_info.core_demands: Fear of exam failure leads to strong distress and affects study focus, thus hoping to obtain professional support to relieve academic fear and improve focus and exam-preparation efficiency.
growth_experiences: 在攻读学位期间长期Lives with parents并承担照料责任，需要在家庭照料与学业之间来回切换。随着期末Exams approaching，时间与精力分配的矛盾加剧，带来显著压力，Family relationships也因此紧张。
此前课程考试与学习任务总体表现Good：规律出勤、按时完成作业并在以往测试中取得not错成绩，但在面对最后一次关键考试时，开始出现前所not yet有的强烈学业not足感与失败恐惧。

core_beliefs: I am not competent enough/能力not足，关键时刻会失败
如果这次考试失败，之前的努力都not算数并会让他人失望

special_situations.event: 夜间躺在床上想到即将到来的期末考试
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I fail this key exam, all my efforts will be reduced to zero
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 向家人寻求再保证、在脑海中not断反复担忧以期“提前应对”
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我一定会挂科，一切努力可能都白费。

special_situations.event: 开始复习时将注意力集中在自己“not懂”的内容上
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果还有很多not会的知识点，就说明我have not准备好且必然not及格
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 加倍学习、not断扩大学习清单以“弥补not足”
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我懂得太少，这样肯定过not了。

special_situations.event: 回想以往测试成绩Good，但把这次视为“not同且更重要”
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 过去的成绩not代表能力，只有这次通过才说明我有价值
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate以往成功、持续提高标准来逼迫自己学习
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 之前做得好也说明not了这次，这次更难、更关键，我还是会失败。

special_situations.event: 在照料父母与备考之间来回切换、时间被频繁打断
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not能同时把照料与学习都处理到位，就会失败并让家人失望
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 试图同时兼顾一切、压缩休息时间以争取学习与照料两端“都not掉线”
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我顾not过来，最后会挂科，还会让大家失望。

core_conflict.wish: 渴望证明自己胜任并被重要他人认可，not让家人失望
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败导致羞耻与被评价，以及辜负家人的期望
defense_goal: 通过过度担忧与高标准来预防失败感
通过寻求再保证来暂时降低Anxiety
以not断加倍努力维持对not确定性的控制感

object_relations.self_representation: 需要同时胜任Student与照料者角色、随时可能做得not够好的“责任承担者”
object_relations.object_representation: The other party (family/significant others) is experienced as an evaluator with expectations who may be disappointed

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师邀请其回顾以往成功或查看现实证据时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者倾向将“这次not同且更重要”作为理由，认为以往的成功not具参考价值
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气温和、先Empathy其压力，再以具体化Questioning引导其同时列举支持与反驳证据，逐步检验“这次not同”的依据。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当谈及“害怕让大家失望”并将他人期待内化为压力时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Attributes others' high expectations and disappointment to the other party (assuming others will judge oneself harshly)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use澄清与界定边界的Questioning，区分事实与推测，鼓励其以第一人称表达需要与界限，降低对他人想法的臆测。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当被邀请同时考虑通过与not yet通过两种结局并做准备时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 在Anxiety中尝试以计划与准备来获得可控感
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Reinforcement其有效的准备行为，采用支持性语气，协助将目标分解与进度回顾常态化，巩固现实检验。

manifestations: Feels torn between caring for parents and self-development (completing the degree), experiencing the tension between choice and responsibility
Worries that failure will disappoint others' expectations; personal choices seem limited by family responsibility
outcomes: Sleep and diet rhythms disrupted，专注力下降

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: 反复自我评估并担心“让所有人失望”，加重内在压力
在备考中持续自我苛责，难以允许自己承认已有进展

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact.
manifestations: 当被邀请回顾既往成功时，将注意力Deflection到“这次not同、更加困难”，回避积极证据
复习时持续将注意力Deflection到“not懂”的部分而忽视已掌握内容

positive_force: 以往测试表现Good，具备学习投入与完成任务的经验
持续规律学习（出勤、笔记、作业完成）
家庭支持可用，尤其是姐姐的情感支持
态度积极，主动求助并愿意尝试现实检验与目标分解
negative_force: 灾难化、预测not yet来与negate积极的认知习惯ReinforcementAnxiety
照料父母与备考的角色冲突造成时间与精力被分散
在学习与睡前情境中Anxiety高涨，影响专注、睡眠与饮食
依赖他人再保证带来短期缓解、长期维持Anxiety的循环

target_behavior.behavior: 与期末考试相关的灾难化担忧与Anticipation失败，伴随Significant anxiety
antecedent: 夜间躺在床上想到即将到来的考试
被家庭照料事务打断学习后重返学习情境
target_behavior.core_reason: Under the dual pressure of care responsibilities and academic goals, forms a catastrophic cognition of failure and infers negative outcomes from it
target_behavior.function: 逃避not确定性、寻求对结果的控制以短暂降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased attention, impaired study efficiency、Sleep and diet rhythm disturbance，进一步削弱备考状态

target_behavior.behavior: Repeatedly seeking reassurance from family (such as asking whether one will pass, whether one is fully prepared)
antecedent: 学习受阻或想到“还not会”的内容时
target_behavior.core_reason: 对自我能力缺乏把握，倾向依赖外部验证以缓解not确定感
target_behavior.function: 获得情绪安抚与即时缓解Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 短期Anxiety下降，但长期Reinforcement依赖与担忧循环，维持对自身能力的not信任
